Position onChange invokes scroll(to:) only if wanted differs from target and not the already-nearest nil-target case. scroll(to:) retires legacy initial owner, calls items.expect, then animates target=wanted.13 target onChange calls ScrollViewProxy.scrollTo using declared center once initial-owner correction is ineligible;14 binds native scrollPosition(id:$target,anchor:anchor).

snap probe is separately installed by BernSnap; it receives rest(start,length), and only initial-owner waiting/generation gate. It does not receive explicit target or coming key. If initialOwner is absent, optional gates also do not suppress snap.

Observer.install sets postsBoundsChangedNotifications and schedulesSnap for every received clip boundsDidChange while !live, without identifying user versus programmatic cause. didEndLiveScroll and wheel momentum end also schedule. Live starts cancel pending and invoke userScroll, but a bounds notification alone does not invoke userScroll.

scheduleSnap cancels/replaces pending then records generation; after0.16, settle checks allowed, same generation,!live,scroll/document/snap, but no explicit-target state. It can compute a different clamped clip origin and use direct scroll or0.18s AppKit animator.

finish is one-shot: guard waiting else return, then waiting=false and generation++. Once initial owner retired, explicit Last or later stops calling finish does not increment generation again. Thus generation does not itself distinguish/cancel a new post-retirement programmatic snap wave.

Pending work cancellation/generation check does not cancel a clip.animator bounds-origin animation that already started. stop removes notifications/monitor and pending; no animation cancellation primitive appears. Completion only reflects the current clip.
